summary: UK warns AI ransomware attack on infrastructure ‘highly likely’ by 2028

summary: South Korea urges exchanges to boost cold storage after Binance hack

summary: North Korea denies role in $6.3B Binance hack, points finger at US

summary: New Jersey drops Coinbase staking order ahead of crypto’s midterm test
briefing: New Jersey lifted its staking ban and dropped a $5 million penalty, clearing the way for Coinbase to restore staking access for users in the US state.

summary: Mystery $106 Million Crypto Theft Hits EU Entity Days After Binance Hack
